name: A Summer Back Home
source:
A SUMMER BACK HOME is a visual where you are a chemical engineer fresh out of university.
Your mother left when you were younger. This made your relationship with your father a tense one. You discover that your dad has a new family living with him back home one day. This discovery was the last straw. You and your father didn't speak after this discovery.
Then a few days after graduation, you get a phone call from your father's girlfriend inviting you to visit them this summer.
When you return home, you are in for a surprise. Your father's family is not what you expected.

And along the way, you will meet new and old friends.
translation:
《A Summer Back Home》是一部视觉小说，你将扮演一名刚刚大学毕业的化学工程师。

母亲在你年幼时离开了，这也使你与父亲的关系十分紧张。某天，你发现父亲已经有了新的家人，正与他们一起住在老家。这成了压垮你们关系的最后一根稻草。从那以后，你便不再与父亲说话。

毕业几天后，你接到父亲女友的电话，邀请你这个夏天去看看他们。

回家之后，等待着你的却是意外：父亲的新家庭，与想象中完全不同。

在这段经历中，你也会遇见新朋友与老相识。
